mentions.name: RED-STAR-WEIGHTLIFTING
mentions.description: A weightlifting logging app for Apple Watch that works entirely standalone, without needing the phone. Users install a workout program in an open format on the watch, log their workouts there, and can export the data for use elsewhere. It is deliberately designed to be anti-memetic and anti-guilt-trip so the workout is a break from the phone. Currently in beta testing and mostly feature complete; it was originally built for ROCKNIX before being ported to Apple's platform.
mentions.problem: Fitness apps tend to guilt-trip users and keep them tied to their phone during workouts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on a weightlifting logging app for the apple watch.  I haven't submitted it yet since I am still beta testing, but I'm mostly feature complete.

It's intended to be anti-memetic, and anti-guilt trip.  Just put it on your watch, install a program (open format) and you never need the phone itself.
